messages:
maria_cs: FYI we got a spend anomaly flag for Arcadia — hosted commit 150k vs usage 215k this week. flagged by spend-monitor :rotating_light:
kevin_billing: saw the alert. pulling billing run logs now, looks like a big token jump overnight at ~23:30 UTC
samir_eng: looking at routing/serving logs, latency was fine but token output spiked. possible routing fallback to higher-cost model variant — checking
maria_cs: spike window per alert: 2025-09-12 23:32 -> 2025-09-13 01:10 UTC. error rate ticked from 0.2% -> 1.6% at peak (small, but not enough to explain 40% cost increase alone)
olivia_account: Arcadia did mention a private test ingestion this week but didn't share schedule. I'll ping their eng lead now
kevin_billing: quick log extract: `billed_tokens: 1.2M` for 23:30-00:00 slice vs normal 320k. opening BILL-910
samir_eng: routing snippet shows fallback triggered due to capacity_pressure on us-west pool. routed to `gpt-04b-std` (higher per-token) for ~28% of requests. log:```[2025-09-12T23:37:41Z] route_id=arcadia-prod fallback=gpt-04b-std reason=pool_saturated```
maria_cs: ok that matches. if fallback caused longer generations that would swell tokens. can we confirm whether prompts changed?
rachel_csm: I checked Arcadia support thread — they pushed a new ingestion job that removed some length limits for debugging, so more context/history per request. looks like combined effect: more tokens + fallback = big delta
kevin_billing: propose provisional credit for overflow while we sort root cause. will draft credit request and cc finance. estimate $6.2k impact over the window
samir_eng: action: opened ENG-4021 to investigate routing policy and autoscaler behavior, added priority label. initial hypothesis: autoscaler didn't scale fast enough during canary burst and fallback policy routed to higher-cost variant. ETA for mitigation: 12-24h
olivia_account: I'll coordinate with Arcadia to gate their ingestion and ask for schedule visibility. can we also set a temporary spend cap in the console to avoid repeat?
maria_cs: yes — set a soft cap and alert to CSM + customer when 80% of commit reached. rachel, can you handle comms?
rachel_csm: will do. I'll draft message asking them to pause the job until we confirm safe rate limits. will include suggested rate and link to docs
kevin_billing: filed BILL-910 and attached preliminary usage graph. finance notified, hold on credits until they approve
maria_cs: summary/action items: 1) ENG-4021 (samir) investigate autoscaler + routing fallback and patch if needed 2) BILL-910 (kevin) prepare credit & finance review 3) CSM outreach (rachel/olivia) coordinate customer pause + guidance 4) temporary soft spend cap and 80% alert (maria + kevin) 5) follow-up sync in 2 hours here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled snapshot of logs for 2025-09-12 23:00-01:30 UTC uploaded to /logs/arcadia/spike-20250912.tar.gz
maria_cs: thanks — will post final update to #customer-success after finance and ENG confirm next steps
